weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 0 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

push.title: L 4-5 vs UK Chargers | You: 8.4 (top 25% MID)
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.4 against UK Chargers. I'd give that a gold star if I could find my sticker book.

DID WELL
+ A brace against UK Chargers. Cool head, quick feet, ball in the onion bag.
+ 0.6 above your usual rating. That's growth, and growth is the whole point.
+ 3 shots on target put +0.1 on the board for you.
+ 8.4 is top 25% stuff for any midfielder.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
- 62% passing (13 of 21, down from your usual 75%). Back to basics: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
- Passes attempted: 21. Nice base. Build to 25+.
- Key passes: 0. One gear up gets you to 2+.
- Lost 4-5. It stings, and stings fade.

Homework: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.

Same time, same energy, next match. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.2. That's what showing up looks like, and it looks good on you.

DID WELL
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. That's patience and aim, the dynamic duo.
+ 2 key passes. Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams.
+ A goal against UK Chargers, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's how you turn a chance into a memory.
+ You & BellyTb1 clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ 0.4 above your usual. Somebody's been practicing.

WORK ON
- Pass accuracy: 80%. Solid ground. The best forwards push it to 88%+.
- Shots: 2. Decent, but top-quarter forwards get to 3+. That's the next rung.
- Goals per shot on target: 50%. Next target: 60%+.
- 4-5 to UK Chargers. Bruised, not broken.

Keep being you. - Coach Lasso
